alicia: Heads-up — CI red on `render-prompt-snapshots` for the example-story prompts. Failing job: https://ci.internal/r/12345 (job 12345)

alicia: Snapshot diff shows extra trailing quote on one line, not sure if serializer change or prompt spacing. Pasted failing excerpt:
```
- expected: \"Tell me a story.\"
+ actual:   \"Tell me a story. \"
```

mohit: thanks for the ping. can you paste the full job log? also which PR touched prompt formatting recently?

alicia: job log snippet attached: `render-worker: stdout: ... render -> sanitize_output -> trim_ws`
alicia: PRs touching serializer: #3841 (unicode quoting), #3860 (newline normalizer) — referencing both.

ci-bot: job 12345 failed on step `snapshot-compare` (exit 1). Trigger: pull/3890. Rerun: https://ci.internal/r/12345/retry

sara: quick check — this looks like an added space before closing quote. newline normalizer sounded risky. @mohit any intuition?

mohit: I suspect the newline normalizer added a normalize-space-around-quotes pass. Could be a regression when prompt ends with punctuation. Quick local repro: 
```
# from repo root
python -m tools.render_test --example examples/story_prompt.json --regen=false
```

mohit: if you can run that locally and then `git bisect` between main~20 and HEAD, should find culprit fast.

alicia: starting bisect on my machine now. will report commit range.

ci-bot: started rerun for pull/3890 (attempt 1)

alicia: bisect update — narrowed to commits 0a1b2c3..0a1b2c9. suspect commit 0a1b2c7 (author: @sara, msg: "trim quotes in serializer").

sara: that PR was meant to trim stray whitespace but we only tested word tokens, missed punctuation edgecase. pushing a quick revert/patch now (will open PR).

dave: quick suggestion — for CI rerun, set env `STRICT_SNAPSHOT=true` to reproduce strict comparison locally. also try `KV_CACHE_PREFIX=1` if you think kvcache affects ordering.

alicia: rerunning job with STRICT_SNAPSHOT=true and without cache. ci link: https://ci.internal/r/12345/attempt/2

ci-bot: rerun attempt 2 failed with same snapshot mismatch.

mohit: ok that confirms serializer change. can you craft a minimal unit test for the prompt case and include in PR to lock the regression?

alicia: opening PR 3891 with failing test and temporary revert of 0a1b2c7. PR body includes repro command and diff of failing snapshot.

sara: reviewing 3891 now. quick fix is two-line change in `quote_normalizer` to not strip before punctuation. patch looks good locally.

ci-bot: PR 3891 triggered CI, job 12378 started.

ci-bot: job 12378 succeeded (green) — snapshots match.

alicia: great — merging 3891. will backfill a regression test and add a changelog note. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
